SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
Translation of French Police Report S. B. D. 8988
No. 3286/B dated December 12, 1930 Date 20 / 1 / 37

Subject:- Mr. TIPOLD.

Baron Tipold, Russian emigrant of Lettish nationality,
arrived in Shanghai from Japan about a month ago.
A former student of the Imperial School at St.
Petersburg, Baron Tipold carried out his military training
in the Corps of Pages' Special course. Promoted sub-lieutenant
in 1916, he took part in the Great War in the ranks of the
Imperial Horse Guards Artillery Brigade. In 1918 he fled
to Harbin and later to Japan. He was first employed by the
Nissen Kissen Kaisha and then later worked on behalf of the
Japanese Ministry of Navy. It was in the capacity of a
representative of this ministry that Tipold was sent to Shanghai
with the object, it is said, of disseminating propaganda
governing Japan's policy in China. It seems that he has
also been instructed to secure information on the activities
of foreigners in Shanghai.
Tipold has at his disposal large sums of money which
permit him to lead a very comfortable existence. He resides
with wife, a Portuguese Eurasian, at Broadway Mansions.
He is being introduced into circles he desires to
approach in Shanghai, by Mr. A. GHERARDI, employed in the
Chinese Maritime Customs, an erstwhile companion of his,
Mr. Gherardi is married to Miss STEVENS, daughter of Mme.
BIRT, wife of a German doctor well known in Shanghai.
Mr. Gherardi lives at 630 Rue Frelupt.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处
法国警方报告 S. B. D. 8988 译文
编号 3286/B，日期 1930 年 12 月 12 日 日期 37 年 1 月 20 日

事由：蒂波尔德（TIPOLD）先生。

蒂波尔德男爵，俄裔拉脱维亚籍流亡者，约一个月前从日本抵达上海。
蒂波尔德男爵曾是圣彼得堡帝国学校的学员，并在侍从武官团特别课程中接受军事训练。1916 年晋升为少尉，在帝国近卫骑兵炮兵旅服役期间参加了第一次世界大战。1918 年他逃往哈尔滨，后转赴日本。他最初受雇于日清汽船株式会社（Nissen Kissen Kaisha），随后代表日本海军省工作。蒂波尔德正是以该省代表的身份被派往上海，据称其目的是散布有关日本对华政策的宣传。看来他还奉命搜集在上海的外国人活动情报。
蒂波尔德手头拥有巨额资金，足以维持非常优渥的生活。他与妻子（一名葡亚混血儿）居住在百老汇大厦。
A·盖拉尔迪（A. GHERARDI）先生正将他引荐给他在上海希望接近的圈子；盖拉尔迪任职于中国海关税务司，是蒂波尔德的旧识。盖拉尔迪娶了史蒂文斯（STEVENS）小姐为妻，史蒂文斯小姐是伯特（BIRT）夫人的女儿，而伯特夫人则是上海一位知名德国医生的妻子。
盖拉尔迪先生居住在弗雷吕普路（Rue Frelupt）630 号。
